title: Kit Fisto
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Kit Fisto was a native of the aquatic planet Glee Anselm. As such, he was as comfortable in water as he was in air-based environments. Fisto's unique alien appearance set him apart from most of his fellow Jedi. He possessed a large number of head tentacles, which allowed him to detect the emotions of others. Kit was one of the 200 Jedi present at the Battle of Geonosis.
